<h2>Description</h2>

<p>Produces one diagnostic plot per incubation from the output of
<code>goAquaFlux</code>: the measured concentration time series, the
diffusive window (shaded), the detected bubbling events, and a compact legend
of the total / diffusive / ebullitive flux estimates.
</p>


<h2>Usage</h2>

<pre><code class='language-R'>flux.plot.aqua(
  flux.results.ls,
  dataframe,
  gastype,
  shoulder = 30,
  plot.display = c("diffusive.window", "ebullition.events"),
  flux.unit = NULL,
  quality.check = FALSE,
  conversion.factor = 1
)
</code></pre>


<h2>Arguments</h2>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="flux.results.ls">flux.results.ls</code></td>
<td>
<p>The list returned by <code>goAquaFlux</code> (with
<code>return_df = TRUE</code>), i.e. a list with <code>flux_summary</code>,
<code>bubbles</code> and <code>diffusive</code>. For backwards compatibility, a plain
<code>best.flux</code>-style data.frame may also be supplied, in which case the
function delegates to <code>flux.plot</code> (diffusion only).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="dataframe">dataframe</code></td>
<td>
<p>The data.frame of measurements used by
<code>goAquaFlux</code> (with <code>Etime</code>, <code>flag</code> and the gas column).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="gastype">gastype</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character; gas column to plot (e.g. <code>"CH4dry_ppb"</code>).</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="shoulder">shoulder</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric; padding (seconds) added before/after the measurement
on the x-axis. Default <code>30</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="plot.display">plot.display</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character vector of elements to overlay. Currently
supported: <code>"diffusive.window"</code> and <code>"ebullition.events"</code>.
Default <code>c("diffusive.window", "ebullition.events")</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="flux.unit">flux.unit</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character or <code>NULL</code>; flux-unit label. If <code>NULL</code>, a
sensible default is chosen from <code>gastype</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="quality.check">quality.check</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical; reserved for quality-check annotations.
Default <code>FALSE</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="conversion.factor">conversion.factor</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric &gt; 0; multiplies displayed flux values.
Default <code>1</code>.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h2>Value</h2>

<p>A list of <code>ggplot</code> objects, one per <code>UniqueID</code>.
</p>


<h2>See Also</h2>

<p><code>goAquaFlux</code>, <code>flux.plot</code>
</p>
